theme_strategy: Light Theme Default (High-Contrast Swiss/Utility for Data Readability in ERP context).

labels.style: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-[10px] md:text-xs, text-slate-500 font-semibold

layouts.general: High-density grid architecture. Sidebar navigation (w-64) + Main Content Area with sticky header.
layouts.dashboard: Bento Grid Pattern (Mode B). 3-tier hierarchy: KPIs (top, col-span-1), Trend Charts (middle, col-span-2 or 3), Data Tables (bottom, col-span-full).
layouts.spacing: Dense spacing for data tables (p-2 to p-4). Generous spacing for headers and page containers (p-6 to p-8).
layouts.borders: The 'Technical Look': grid borders (border-collapse, border-slate-200, 1px solid). No soft shadows.

components.auth: Split screen layout. Left side minimal form, Right side structural/architectural image overlay (bg-black/30).
components.cards: Flat surfaces, 1px border-slate-200, sharp edges (rounded-md max).
components.tables: Compact row heights (h-10 or h-12). Sticky headers. Use badge components for status columns (Draft, Approval Stages, PO, Receipt).
components.timeline: Vertical stepped timeline for tracking PR progress and warehouse receipts.
components.forms: Multi-column grid forms for PR creation. Inline validation.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Sheet (slide-out panels from right) for PR/PO Details, Tender bids, and LS Document uploads, preserving table context.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid. Avoid Glassmorphism entirely as it reduces data readability in financial/logistics ERPs.
visual_enhancers.motion: Minimalistic. Staggered fade-ins (opacity/translate-y) for table rows and list items.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for crisp, professional scaling in dense UI.

auth_background.description: Curved white architectural ribs - Use for main admin/procurement auth screen.

vendor_portal_background.description: Aerial view of shipping containers - Use for vendor portal auth or logistics bonded zone sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: Write code using standard .js and .jsx files, NOT .tsx (TypeScript).
Build a robust sidebar navigation accommodating multi-role access (Admin, Procurement, Requester, Approver, Warehouse, Vendor, Finance).
Implement high-density Data Tables with inline actions, checkboxes for bulk actions (like merging multiple PRs to PO), and clear status badges.
Design a PR Creation page with a dynamic multi-level approval matrix visualizer.
Include a Budget validation UI element (e.g., Progress bar showing budget consumption when creating a PR).
Create a Vendor Portal view featuring open tenders, bidding actions, and invoice submissions.
For the Kawasan Berikat (Bonded Zone) module, design a document upload section (LS, customs) with HS Code selectors and separate tabs for Local vs Bonded POs.
Use Phosphor icons. Install with: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Add 'data-testid' attributes to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows) using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='submit-pr-button').
universal_guidelines: NEVER use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or modals that sit above content.
Do not apply global transitions (e.g., transition: all).
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Add hover/focus states to all interactive elements with explicitly increased contrast.
Avoid using card components excessively. Go flat, rectangular, dense styles for Data UI.
